text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run AI Moderator
        id: ai-moderator
        uses: actions/ai-inference@v1
        with:
          prompt: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          model: "gpt-3.5-turbo"
          enable-github-mcp: true
          github-mcp-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Label issue if spam
        if: steps.ai-moderator.outputs.response == 'spam'
        run: |
          gh issue edit ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --add-label spam

      - name: Minimize comment if spam
        if: steps.ai-moderator.outputs.response == 'spam'
        run: |
          gh issue comment edit ${{ github.event.comment.id }} --minimized
```
